g.title: '@TRAP (USR1): echo "USR1_HANDLER"\, trap "echo USR1_NESTED" USR1 :: @TRAP (RETURN): echo NESTED_RETURN 0' (32,122 us, 0.76%)
'@TRAP (EXIT): echo "EXIT $depth"\, trap "echo NESTED_EXIT $depth" EXIT :: @TRAP (RETURN): echo NESTED_RETURN 2' (54,280 us, 1.28%)

'$'''cat <<-'''EVAL_HEREDOC'''
{
 for i in {1..2}, do
 ( recursive_bg 2 ) &
 done
} | tee >(cat >&2) >/dev/null &
EVAL_HEREDOC
' (1,593 us, 0.04%)
'@TRAP (EXIT): echo "EXIT $depth"\, trap "echo NESTED_EXIT $depth" EXIT :: @TRAP (RETURN): echo NESTED_RETURN 1' (27,907 us, 0.66%)

'$'''eval "$(cat <<-'''NESTED'''
for ((i=0, i<2, i++)), do
 ( eval "echo NESTED-${depth}-\$i" ) &
done
wait
NESTED
)"' (2,430 us, 0.06%)
